name: Eerie Worlds
storyline: a "Rift" that has opened, breaking down the barriers between realms and allowing shadows and malevolent beings to spill into our world. Players must restore balance by either vanquishing these creatures or bringing them to their side as allies. Guided by an ancient grimoire, players will learn to harness the powers of these creatures and master the newly formed alliances. The game draws inspiration from folklore, mythology, and documented events, immersing players in a world where horror and myth converge.
